description: Delivery layout for every Track B game: the vendor samples' top level plus per-scenario gameplay videos, README screenshots and the packaged build. docs/game-deliverable.md, section 'Dataset layout v1', is the prose version of this file; tools/validate-dataset.ps1 checks against this file.

entries.name: README.md
entries.what: game, how to play and open it, how to replay the creation, scenario videos, screenshots, licences

entries.name: git.log
entries.what: every commit, oldest first: message, anonymised author, dates, full text diff; binary and LFS files as path + sha256

entries.name: workflow.jsonl
entries.what: editor operations, one row each, written when the operation happened

entries.name: replay.mp4
entries.what: screen recording of the creation replay (from the replay session)

entries.name: UEProject
entries.what: the project at the release commit (with or without store content); in the repo the repository itself is the project

entries.name: ReplayScripts
entries.what: scripts that replay the creation from workflow.jsonl (from the replay session)

entries.name: Gameplay
entries.what: one video per scenario of the release version

entries.name: Screenshots
entries.what: the README hero and gallery images, linked from README.md by relative path

entries.name: manifest.json
entries.what: metadata and path, bytes, sha256 of every other file

blocking: the account name (exact-token allowlist: zh_XIANG, zh-xiang, WuXiangShan...)
